summary: Idaho-Montana line lookout: established 1933, L-4 cab built 1934, destroyed 1962; cab footings with carved names were still there at a 2025 visit.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1962; cement footings of the cab were still on site at a 2025 visit.

corrections.why: Idaho pages, firelookout.com, the Shoshone County list and the Idaho staffing account (cite 5) put the site in the St. Joe National Forest. Only the Montana list gives Kootenai. The editor should confirm.
The 2025 Idaho post found cement footings for the cab on site. The ruins status covers footings or remains only.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho pages and the Shoshone County list say St. Joe National Forest. The Montana list says Kootenai National Forest. The story reports the disagreement.
The 2025 post describes footings for the L-4 cab. A separate account of a visit calls the site the ruins of a fallen tower. The story does not name the structure type.

notes_for_editor: Elevation is 6,032 feet, about 1,839 m, in the Idaho and firelookout.com pages; elevation_m is null in the record and no elevation key exists in facts. No source gives a tower height, so height_m is not set. The 1938 N.B. Benson entry is uncertain, since the footing reads 193? and the team asked for help. The 1933 start date rests on the 1933 newspaper item quoted on the Montana list and the Idaho post. No source says whether the site is open to the public, so facts.access is not set. Notable fires: none in these sources. The Shoshone County list also has a separate BLUFF (DOMINION) entry (44N-7E-12), which is a different site.
